Check the daily timetable on your ERP portal for room changes. Usually, core subjects are in Block A! 🏢
Room details are updated on the department notice board and student portal. Don't be late!

🕗 College: 8:30 AM – 3:30 PM
Lunch: 12:30 PM
Fee days: till 4:30 or 5:30 PM
Saturday: Holiday 🎉

Saturday is always a holiday at Atria! 🎉

Unless officially announced, assume you have classes. Check the portal! 🎒

🚨 Emergency: Go to Medical Room — Ground Floor, Block B
Contact security gate immediately!
Medical staff available on campus.
Lost ID? Go to Admin Block for a temporary pass & apply for duplicate (fee applies). Bring a passport photo! 🪪

📶 WiFi login: Student Registration Number + ERP password.
Issues? Complain to the IT desk in the computer lab.
Forgot ERP password? Click 'Forgot Password' → OTP on your registered email. 💻
Portal slow? Try again in 10 minutes — heavy traffic during results time! 😅

📈 CGPA: Check ERP Portal → Results
Aim for 8.0+, minimum 6.5 for placements. Keep grinding! 💪

🏅 Scholarships: Forms released in August.
Visit Admin Office → Scholarship Desk for eligibility. Check notice board for deadlines!

Hostel curfew: 7:30 PM strictly.
Late entry or overnight leave? Need warden approval + parent's call! 🚪

🍽️ Canteen — Ground Floor
Opens: 10:30 AM
Serves: Snacks, meals, tea, coffee
Cash & UPI accepted. Closed Saturdays!
